SELECT t.tweet_id, t.text AS tweet_text, t.created_at, a.sentiment, a.impressions, a.engagement_rate, a.engagement_value, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT h.hashtag_text ORDER BY h.hashtag_text SEPARATOR ', ') AS hashtags_used, (a.engagement_value + COALESCE(t.retweet_count, 0) + COALESCE(t.favorite_count, 0)) AS total_engagements, ROUND((a.engagement_rate * 100), 2) AS engagement_percentage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.engagement_rate DESC) AS engagement_rank FROM tweets t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN analytics a ON t.tweet_id = a.tweet_id LEFT JOIN tweet_hashtags th ON t.tweet_id = th.tweet_id LEFT JOIN hashtags h ON th.hashtag_id = h.hashtag_id WHERE u.screen_name = 'exampleUser' GROUP BY t.tweet_id, t.text, t.created_at, a.sentiment, a.impressions, a.engagement_rate, a.engagement_value, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count ORDER BY t.created_at DESC;

SELECT c.cache_name, c.cache_type, c.max_size AS max_memory_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN cm.metric = 'max_hit_ratio' THEN cm.value END) AS max_hit_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.app_id) AS number_of_applications, SUM(cu.hits) AS total_hits, SUM(cu.misses) AS total_misses, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.parameter = 'max_time_to_idle_seconds' THEN cc.value END) AS max_time_to_idle_seconds FROM caches c LEFT JOIN cache_usage cu ON c.cache_id = cu.cache_id LEFT JOIN cache_monitoring cm ON c.cache_id = cm.cache_id LEFT JOIN cache_configurations cc ON c.cache_id = cc.cache_id WHERE c.read_only = 1 AND c.max_size > 500000 AND c.eviction_policy = 'LRU' AND c.time_to_live_seconds > 600 GROUP BY c.cache_id, c.cache_name, c.cache_type, c.max_size ORDER BY total_hits DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE region_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        region_name,
        parent_region_id,
        CAST(region_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS full_path
    FROM geographic_regions
    WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        gr.region_id,
        gr.region_name,
        gr.parent_region_id,
        CONCAT(rp.full_path, ' > ', gr.region_name) AS full_path
    FROM geographic_regions gr
    INNER JOIN region_paths rp ON gr.parent_region_id = rp.region_id
),
dataset_access_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.dataset_id,
        d.dataset_name,
        d.description,
        d.source,
        COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count,
        MAX(al.access_date) AS latest_access_date
    FROM datasets d
    INNER JOIN access_logs al ON d.dataset_id = al.data_id
    GROUP BY d.dataset_id, d.dataset_name, d.description, d.source
    HAVING COUNT(al.access_id) >= 1
)
SELECT 
    rp.full_path AS region_full_path,
    dac.dataset_name,
    dac.description,
    dac.source,
    dac.access_count,
    dac.access_count AS cumulative_access_count
FROM region_paths rp
INNER JOIN region_dataset rd ON rp.region_id = rd.region_id
INNER JOIN dataset_access_counts dac ON rd.dataset_id = dac.dataset_id
ORDER BY dac.latest_access_date DESC, rp.full_path, dac.access_count DESC;

WITH ranked_awards AS (
    SELECT 
        a.awardee_id,
        a.chapter_id,
        a.year_of_award,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.chapter_id ORDER BY a.year_of_award DESC) AS award_rank
    FROM awards a
    WHERE a.year_of_award IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(aw.first_name, ' ', aw.last_name) AS awardee_name,
    c.location AS chapter_location,

FROM ranked_awards ra
JOIN awardees aw ON ra.awardee_id = aw.awardee_id
JOIN chapters c ON ra.chapter_id = c.chapter_id

ORDER BY c.chapter_id, ra.award_rank;

WITH department_monthly_overtime AS (
    SELECT 
        e.department,
        DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(o.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(s.shift_duration) AS total_approved_overtime_hours
    FROM overtime_requests o
    JOIN shifts s ON o.shift_id = s.shift_id
    JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
    WHERE o.request_status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY e.department, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(o.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m')
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        month,
        total_approved_overtime_hours,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY total_approved_overtime_hours DESC) AS rank_position
    FROM department_monthly_overtime
)
SELECT 
    department,
    month,
    total_approved_overtime_hours
FROM ranked_months
WHERE rank_position = 1
ORDER BY department, month;

WITH LatestYearData AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bank_name,
        i.industry_name,
        bid.value AS roe_value,
        bid.year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.industry_id ORDER BY bid.value DESC) AS rank_in_industry
    FROM 
        bank_industry_data bid
    JOIN 
        banks b ON bid.bank_id = b.bank_id
    JOIN 
        industries i ON bid.industry_id = i.industry_id
    JOIN 
        financial_metrics fm ON bid.metric_id = fm.metric_id
    WHERE 
        fm.metric_name = 'Return on Equity (ROE)'
        AND bid.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM bank_industry_data WHERE metric_id = bid.metric_id)
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    bank_name,
    roe_value
FROM 
    LatestYearData
WHERE 
    rank_in_industry <= 3
ORDER BY 
    industry_name ASC,

),
ranked_tweets AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY total_engagement DESC) AS engagement_rank
    FROM filtered_tweets
)
SELECT 
    username,
    user_id,
    tweet_id,
    timestamp,
    text,
    hashtags,
    retweets,
    favorites
FROM ranked_tweets
WHERE engagement_rank <= 3
ORDER BY user_id, total_engagement DESC;

        ps.rbis,

    FROM ranked_stats

    SELECT 
        p.page_id,
        p.name,
        p.path,
        ph.parent_page_id,
        0 AS level
    FROM pages p
    LEFT JOIN page_hierarchy ph ON p.page_id = ph.child_page_id
    WHERE ph.parent_page_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        p.page_id,
        p.name,
        p.path,
        ph.parent_page_id,
        pt.level + 1 AS level

WITH ProductSales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM 
        order_items oi
    JOIN 
        products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.product_id, p.product_name
    ORDER BY 
        total_quantity_sold DESC
),
TopProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        total_quantity_sold
    FROM 
        ProductSales
    LIMIT 3
),
BottomProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        total_quantity_sold
    FROM 
        ProductSales
    ORDER BY 
        total_quantity_sold ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
LowStockProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_name,
        s.size_category AS size,
        i.stock_quantity
    FROM 
        inventory i
    JOIN 
        products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN 
        sizes s ON i.size_id = s.size_id
    WHERE 
        i.stock_quantity <= i.low_stock_alert
),
CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS customer_name,
        SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount_spent
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY 
        total_amount_spent DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM 
        orders o
    WHERE 
        o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date != ''
    GROUP BY 
        DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m')
    ORDER BY 
        month
)
SELECT 
    'Top Three Selling Products' AS report_section,
    product_name,
    total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    TopProducts
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Bottom Three Selling Products' AS report_section,
    product_name,
    total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    BottomProducts
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Low-Stock Products' AS report_section,
    CONCAT(product_name, ' (Size: ', size, ')') AS product_name,
    stock_quantity AS total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    LowStockProducts
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Top Five Spending Customers' AS report_section,
    customer_name AS product_name,
    total_amount_spent AS total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    CustomerSpending
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Monthly Sales Amounts' AS report_section,
    month AS product_name,
    total_sales_amount AS total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    MonthlySales;

WITH neighbourhood_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        n.neighbourhood_id,
        n.neighbourhood_name,
        n.average_property_value,
        SUM(s.sale_price) AS total_sales_value,
        AVG(s.sale_price / ht.average_sqft) AS avg_price_per_sqft
    FROM neighbourhoods n
    JOIN agent_listings al ON n.neighbourhood_id = al.neighbourhood_id
    JOIN sales s ON al.listing_id = s.listing_id
    JOIN house_types ht ON al.house_type_id = ht.house_type_id
    GROUP BY n.neighbourhood_id, n.neighbourhood_name, n.average_property_value
),
top_neighbourhood AS (
    SELECT 
        neighbourhood_id,
        neighbourhood_name,
        average_property_value,
        total_sales_value,
        avg_price_per_sqft
    FROM neighbourhood_sales
    ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

        b.buyer_name,
        b.preferred_neighbourhoods
    FROM buyers b

    JOIN agent_listings al ON s.listing_id = al.listing_id
    JOIN neighbourhoods n ON al.neighbourhood_id = n.neighbourhood_id
    WHERE n.neighbourhood_id = (SELECT neighbourhood_id FROM top_neighbourhood)
    GROUP BY b.buyer_id, b.buyer_name, b.preferred_neighbourhoods
)

WITH RECURSIVE category_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        category_id,
        category_name,
        parent_category_id,
        CAST(category_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS full_path
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        c.parent_category_id,
        CONCAT(cp.full_path, ' > ', c.category_name)
    FROM categories c
    INNER JOIN category_paths cp ON c.parent_category_id = cp.category_id
),
last_accesses AS (
    SELECT 
        item_id,
        user_id,
        access_date,
        access_type,
        access_reason,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY access_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM item_access_logs
),
vote_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        item_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'no' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote_cast = 'abstain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstain_votes
    FROM votes
    GROUP BY item_id
)
SELECT 
    pi.item_id,
    pi.title,
    cp.full_path AS category_full_path,
    pi.tabled_date,
    pi.plenary_date,
    pi.item_type,
    pi.description,
    pi.status,
    si.sequence_number,
    si.session_id,
    la.user_id AS last_access_user_id,
    la.access_date AS last_access_date,
    la.access_type AS last_access_type,
    la.access_reason AS last_access_reason,
    COALESCE(vc.yes_votes, 0) AS yes_votes,
    COALESCE(vc.no_votes, 0) AS no_votes,
    COALESCE(vc.abstain_votes, 0) AS abstain_votes
FROM plenary_items pi
LEFT JOIN category_paths cp ON pi.category_id = cp.category_id
LEFT JOIN session_items si ON pi.item_id = si.item_id
LEFT JOIN last_accesses la ON pi.item_id = la.item_id AND la.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN vote_counts vc ON pi.item_id = vc.item_id
ORDER BY si.sequence_number, pi.item_id;

    SELECT loan_type_id
    FROM loan_types
    WHERE CAST(REPLACE(interest_rate_range, '%', '') AS DECIMAL(5,2)) BETWEEN 3.00 AND 7.00
),
ranked_applications AS (
    SELECT 
        la.application_id,
        la.loan_type_id,
        la.risk_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY la.loan_type_id

    INNER JOIN filtered_loan_types flt ON la.loan_type_id = flt.loan_type_id

)

FROM ranked_applications
WHERE risk_rank <= 3
ORDER BY loan_type_id, risk_rank;

    GROUP BY m.competition_id, m.team_id
),

        up.ticker,

        up.purchase_price,
        sd.close_price AS current_price,
        up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price AS initial_value,
        up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price AS current_value,
        (up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price) - (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) AS gain,
        ((up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price) - (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price)) / (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) * 100 AS portfolio_return_percent
    FROM user_portfolios up
    JOIN stock_data sd ON up.ticker = sd.ticker

),

        SUM(gain) AS total_gain,
        SUM(gain) AS total_net_gain,
        AVG(portfolio_return_percent) AS avg_portfolio_return_percent
    FROM portfolio_calculations
    GROUP BY user_id
)

WITH class_avg_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.class_id,
        AVG(er.score) AS avg_class_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.student_id) AS students_attended
    FROM exam_results er
    JOIN students s ON er.student_id = s.student_id
    GROUP BY s.class_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_class_score) AS overall_avg_score
    FROM class_avg_scores
)
SELECT 
    cas.class_id,
    cas.avg_class_score,
    cas.students_attended,
    en.note
FROM class_avg_scores cas
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
LEFT JOIN exams e ON FIND_IN_SET(cas.class_id, e.class_ids) > 0
LEFT JOIN exam_notes en ON e.exam_id = en.exam_id
WHERE cas.avg_class_score > oa.overall_avg_score
GROUP BY cas.class_id, cas.avg_class_score, cas.students_attended, en.note;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(e.enrollment_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.course_review_id) AS reviews
    FROM enrollments e
    LEFT JOIN course_reviews cr ON e.student_id = cr.student_id
    WHERE e.enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND e.enrollment_date != ''
    GROUP BY YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(e.enrollment_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        enrollments,
        reviews,
        CASE 
            WHEN enrollments > 0 THEN reviews / enrollments 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS ratio
    FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT 
    year,
    enrollments,
    reviews,
    ratio,
    AVG(ratio) OVER (
        ORDER BY year 
        ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_ratio
FROM ratio_calc
ORDER BY year;

WITH vote_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        legislation_id,
        legislation_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Not Voting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_voting_votes
    FROM voting_records
    WHERE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(vote_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2022
    GROUP BY legislation_id, legislation_name
),
vote_differences AS (
    SELECT 
        legislation_id,
        legislation_name,
        yes_votes,
        no_votes,
        not_voting_votes,
        ABS(yes_votes - no_votes) AS vote_difference
    FROM vote_counts
),
max_difference AS (
    SELECT 
        legislation_id,
        legislation_name,
        yes_votes,
        no_votes,
        not_voting_votes
    FROM vote_differences
    WHERE vote_difference = (SELECT MAX(vote_difference) FROM vote_differences)
),
financial_data AS (
    SELECT 
        vr.legislation_id,
        AVG(cf.amount_supported) AS avg_amount_supported,
        AVG(cf.amount_opposed) AS avg_amount_opposed
    FROM voting_records vr
    JOIN campaign_financing cf ON vr.candidate_id = cf.candidate_id
    WHERE vr.legislation_id IN (SELECT legislation_id FROM max_difference)
        AND cf.year = 2022
    GROUP BY vr.legislation_id
)
SELECT 
    md.legislation_name,
    md.yes_votes,
    md.no_votes,
    md.not_voting_votes,
    fd.avg_amount_supported,
    fd.avg_amount_opposed
FROM max_difference md
JOIN financial_data fd ON md.legislation_id = fd.legislation_id
LIMIT 1;
